goal: Generate an outdoor scene of Mars in the morning, suitable for the main visual of a simulation game expansion on community building, with a solemn yet hopeful atmosphere.

world.theme: First expansion of the dome operations at the low-latitude Mars northern hemisphere colony
world.tone: Just after the dust storm, extremely low saturation, the landscape is barren, with strong contrasting horizon light

composition.foreground: Two silhouette workers in exoskeletons facing away from the viewer, one squatting and one standing checking ground stake connections, with fine dust wind patterns in the landscape
composition.midground: Low-lying transparent composite dome and silver pipeline corridor, with distant tracked mining vehicles and signal towers forming geometric silhouettes in the dust and haze.
composition.background: Pale sun disk rising at the end of the reddish-brown plateau and thin high clouds dyed golden orange
composition.perspective: Slightly looking down towards the horizon, emphasizing the width of the ground.

lighting.key_light: 自地平线向上的暖侧光，尘粒被照亮为体积雾
lighting.fill_light: Cool blue fill light under the dome, from reflective film.
lighting.atmosphere: Dust suspended in the air, distant light dust rolling but not obscuring the main sun.

color_palette: Rust red, earth yellow, corona gold white, zenith deep blue, with partial cool cyan reflections on equipment
title_safe_area: Top right dark void preserves title and English subtitle safe zone

style.rendering: "The Martian" + next-gen game concept art blended, realistic materials

must_keep: Humans are insignificant compared to planetary scales
Only one main light source: the sun is on one side of the image
No terrestrial vegetation and blue oceans.
No recognizable NASA/commercial logo, gear is designed in a general sci-fi style
avoid: Paint Mars in an indistinguishable gray-brown from Earth
Multiple large moons appearing at the zenith disrupt the sense of scale.
